name: adsync
description: AdSync monorepo: backend API, frontend app and landing site.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix landing
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend,landing -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix landing"
